members.working:
1. Magnetite formula Fe3O4 contains 4 O atoms per formula unit.
2. Given O atoms = 4.78 × 10^22. Moles O = 4.78e22 / 6.022e23 = 0.0795 mol O.
3. Moles Fe3O4 = moles O / 4 = 0.0199 mol Fe3O4.
4. Moles Fe = 3 × moles Fe3O4 = 0.0597 mol Fe.
5. In acidic medium, permanganate oxidizes Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺; each Fe²⁺ gives 1 equivalent.
6. Total equivalents of Fe in the whole solution = 0.0597 eq.
7. Aliquot volume = 32.8 mL out of total 277 mL → fraction = 32.8/277.
8. Equivalents in aliquot = 0.0597 × (32.8/277) = 0.00708 eq.
9. Normality of KMnO4 = 0.0627 N = 0.0627 eq/L.
10. Volume of KMnO4 needed for titration (L) = equivalents / N = 0.00708 / 0.0627 = 0.1129 L.
11. Convert to mL: 0.1129 L × 1000 = 112.9 mL.
12. Round to 3 significant figures → 113 mL.
Thus the volume of KMnO4 solution used to titrate the 32.8 mL aliquot is 113 mL.

Fe₃O₄ + 4H₂SO₄ → FeSO₄ + Fe₂(SO₄)₃ + 4H₂O

So Fe₃O₄ gives 1 mol Fe²⁺ and 1 mol Fe₂(SO₄)₃ (which contains 2 mol Fe³⁺).
